description.zh: 草稿整理成正式标准：英文为准，附中文版和标准词表；网页、PDF 和 Markdown 都从同一份源生成。
description.en: The draft consolidated into a formal standard: English normative, with a Chinese version and the standard word list; the web pages, PDFs and Markdown are all built from one source.

title.zh: 工具链 0.1：网页版和桌面版查看器

description.zh: 运行库、SPICE 与 Spectre 适配器、渲染器和 rnl 命令；网页版查看器上线，Windows 桌面版 0.1.0 发布。能打开带 RNL 的网表，画出有坐标的部分。
description.en: The runtime, the SPICE and Spectre adapters, the renderer and the rnl command; the web viewer goes online and the Windows desktop viewer 0.1.0 is released. They open a netlist with RNL and draw what has coordinates.

description.zh: 核心的 WebAssembly 版本以预览版发布到 npm：@rich-netlist/runtime，标签 next。
description.en: The core as WebAssembly is published to npm as a preview: @rich-netlist/runtime, under the tag next.

description.zh: 求解器要把每个决定都写回文件，让不求解的查看器也能画出同样的图：没有名字可指的对象有编号，自动导线的走法也写回。标准包的 0.3 系列把名字写全；正式标准附中文版，0.2 的文件照样能读。
description.en: The solver must write back every decision it makes, so that a viewer that does not solve draws what it drew: objects that no name reaches have numbers, and the routes of automatic wires are written back. The standard series 0.3 spells its names out in full; the formal standard comes with a Chinese version, and files of 0.2 still read.

title.zh: RNL skill 包和“给 agent”页
title.en: The RNL skill package and the page for agents

description.zh: 写给 AI agent 的 skill 包（Agent Skills 格式）：简明指南、标准包参考、工具说明和例子；本站有了给 agent 的页和 llms.txt。
description.en: A skill package for AI agents (Agent Skills format): a short guide, a reference to the standard packages, notes on the tools and examples; this site has a page for agents and an llms.txt.

description.zh: 桌面版能编辑文本、保存，能求解并作为预览显示，还能列出没画出来的元件；读语言 0.3 的文件。
description.en: The desktop viewer edits the text and saves it, solves and shows the result as a preview, and lists the objects that are not drawn; it reads files of language 0.3.

description.zh: eda-style 提供 EDA 原理图符号和外观；SKY130 符号包改名为 pdk-sky130。扩展包按需引入，核心只内置标准包。
description.en: eda-style provides EDA schematic symbols and styling; the SKY130 package is renamed pdk-sky130. Extensions are included explicitly, while the core bundles only the standard packages.

description.zh: @rich-netlist/runtime 发布 0.1.0-preview.13 和 preview.14，继续通过 next 分发核心的 WebAssembly 版本。
description.en: @rich-netlist/runtime publishes 0.1.0-preview.13 and preview.14, continuing to distribute the WebAssembly core under next.

description.zh: 网页版支持只显示画布的嵌入模式；其他网页可以通过消息接口打开网表、切换层级、缩放和调整背景，不必重新加载。
description.en: The web viewer gains a canvas-only embedding mode. Other pages can open netlists, navigate levels, fit the drawing and change its background through messages without reloading.

title.zh: 网站导航、Logo 和包页面
title.en: Site navigation, logo and package gallery

description.zh: 网站统一导航和侧栏，包图库按标准系列、扩展和 PDK 分组；Logo 可展开成交互原理图，图库增加原点开关。
description.en: The site gains shared navigation and sidebars, package groups for standard series, extensions and PDKs, an interactive circuit logo, and an origin toggle in the gallery.

title.zh: 符号和外观分成两个公开包

description.zh: eda-symbol 提供 137 个原理图符号；独立的 eda-style 为标准、自定义和 EDA 符号统一设置外观，两者可以分别使用。
description.en: eda-symbol supplies 137 schematic symbols; the independent eda-style styles standard, custom and EDA symbols. Either package can be used on its own.

description.zh: 可选公开包移到 rnl-packages 仓库；查看器和网站按版本清单获取文件并校验 SHA256，标准包仍内置在核心里。
description.en: Optional public packages move to rnl-packages. The viewers and site fetch versioned files from its catalog and verify SHA256; the standard packages remain built into the core.

title.zh: 外部网站打开完整 Viewer
title.en: Open the complete Viewer from another site

description.zh: 完整 Viewer 与嵌入模式共用导入接口，支持网表、URL 和指定版本的公开包；其他网站可打开或复用 Viewer 标签页，并取消被新请求替代的导入。
description.en: The complete Viewer and embedded mode share an import API for netlists, URLs and exact public-package versions. Other sites can open or reuse a Viewer tab and cancel superseded imports.

title.zh: 桌面版查看器 0.1.4 与 npm 预览包 15

description.zh: 查看器新增中英文界面、Auto Include、编译与绘图缓存和后台预加载；@rich-netlist/runtime 发布 0.1.0-preview.15。
description.en: The Viewer adds English and Chinese UI, Auto Include, compilation and drawing caches, and background preloading; @rich-netlist/runtime publishes 0.1.0-preview.15.

description.zh: 计划中：按端子个数选符号；新增 @SOLVER-CONFIG。
description.en: Planned: symbols chosen by the number of terminals; the new @SOLVER-CONFIG.

title.zh: 求解器优化目标，第二版

description.zh: 计划中：标准包里的名字不再写在求解器里，改由配置给出，0.3 的文件里电流方向、地的方向和信号流向这几个目标也就有对象可管。
description.en: Planned: the names of the standard package move out of the solver into its configuration, so that in a file of 0.3 the objectives for current direction, ground direction and signal flow have something to act on.
